This lecture covers:
• Improving generative AI chatbots' influence on public mental health as a case study
• A new way of thinking about "designing AI for societal good," namely "designing AI as planting seeds" (of better business models, policy, and politics)
• Early work that explores this design practice and research agenda
Qian Yang is an assistant professor in Computing and Information Science at Cornell University and a human-computer interaction (HCI) design researcher.
